page_topic_one_liner: Marketing glossary reference — 170+ terms covering growth, conversion, channels, B2B, and content marketing
differentiator_vs_generic: This is a single-domain marketing term index / dictionary page, NOT the three-pillar glossary hub, NOT a growth-strategy guide or affiliate dashboard, NOT a single term definition. Hero must be an A–Z glossary index dense with marketing-specific term rows and chip cloud — NOT generic funnel chart alone or empty cards.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Marketing glossary index mockup — vertical A–Z alphabet sidebar (letter pills), main column with 6–8 stacked term rows (blurred marketing term titles like CAC, funnel, attribution + one-line definition blur), one row accent-highlighted
Secondary: dictionary page spread vignette — open reference spread with highlighted marketing term block and definition blur lines
Tertiary: floating term chip cloud (8–10 blurred marketing-domain chips: CAC, LTV, MQL, funnel, attribution, ROAS, etc.) clustered beside index
anti_patterns: Three-pillar hub cards (SEO/Marketing/AI) — this is Marketing-only glossary
Affiliate dashboard or email campaign UI as hero (this is term reference not channel guide)
Generic growth chart as sole visual without glossary index layout
Single term definition hero (one word + long paragraph)
Empty term rows or HubSpot/Mailchimp logos as readable text
